sense.text:
“Be in peace with many: nevertheless have but one counsellor of a thousand.” There is nothing wrong with having a counsellor, but be careful who you are counselling. This is for the brothers and the sisters both.

Married brothers should not be counselling sisters, and neither should single brothers. We have sisters here for that. Not at the table after class, but during the week, on the phone, talking about counselling her: no. You are setting yourself up. Everybody who has a friendly face on is not what you think they are.

Any sister who skips over hundreds of sisters to call a brother for counsel has the devil on her. Satan is right at your door, and the higher you are, the more Satan is coming for you, and he will use a brother or a sister to get you. Some of you think, I can handle it. Good luck with that. Some of you will fall for the okey-dokey. None of you should have a sister's phone number in your phone talking about I'm her counsellor. Satan is not sleeping; he is right there in the midst of it.

Satan is not sleeping. As you see chaos happening in the world, Satan knows his days are numbered, and he is going to take as much with him as he can, some of you included.

“My son, if thou come to serve the Lord”: we all say we come to serve Messiah. Then “prepare thy soul for temptation.” Prepare yourself, because temptation comes every way, from every side, not from one side. For some of you it is cigarettes, for some crack cocaine, for some the big butt woman, for some the men. This is for the men and the women. Never think you stand and cannot fall, or you will fall.

“Set thy heart aright”: set your mind right. It is all about your mind.

“And constantly endure”: that does not only mean endure to the end. Constantly endure means continue to fight, do not give up, watch for the devil. Satan is at the door of every one of us; the question is whether you are going to let him in. He will always be at your door, waiting for you to open it, and all he needs is a little crack, just enough to fit himself in, and he will fit in there.

“And make not haste in time of trouble”: when the time of trouble comes, don't run. Take the correction and keep it moving. Repent and keep it moving.

This is the scripture that says Esau was lying from the time he came out of his mother: “The wicked are estranged from the womb.” Nobody is more wicked than Esau. If you don't see the evil in Esau, something is wrong with you.

This month alone is enough to prove that the white man is surely the devil, without a shadow of a doubt. And not a regular demon: the white man is so evil it is as though Satan came from him, as though Satan were the children of the white man. These people can look you right in your eyes without blinking and lie plainly, and want you to believe it. Every word out of the media's mouth is a lie, and most of the American people believe it.

The name of the class is the storm before the kingdom. We all want the kingdom of heaven, but it will not come without tribulation and war. Every kingdom in history fell with war before it. What we are looking at is not World War III yet, but it is going to lead to it. Some of us are going to be taken out, some persecuted. Forget the kingdom for a minute: are you ready for what comes before it? You're not ready, we're not ready. There is a lot we have to work on, and some of our minds are not right yet.

“For there shall be sedition among men, and invading one another; they shall not regard their kings nor princes, and the course of their actions shall stand in their power.”

The media wants you to believe Iran is weak and has no power, yet Iran has struck seven countries in the region besides America and Israel. Iran is not attacking those countries to kill the people; it is attacking the American bases. Every one of those countries is Muslim, and their governments are puppets of America and Israel. What Iran is doing is turning the people against those governments, breaking their economies so the people rise up and kick America out of the bases. Iran is uniting the Arab world: sedition among men, and the people not regarding their kings nor princes.

Killing Soleimani was a big mistake, because in the Arab world he was looked on like the pope. Iran has turned this into a holy war, and you know how the Arab world acts in a holy war. This is just the beginning; it is going to get worse. Three times Donald Trump asked for a ceasefire and Iran said no. If they had no weapons to fight with, why would they say no? Keep your eyes open and stop listening to the media that is lying to you.

“Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots”: the dragons of Arabia are the Arabs, the Arab world. Many chariots means they are going to come with power.

“And the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth”: there will be a lot of them. “That all they which hear them may fear and tremble”: when the Arab world unites, those who hear of them will fear, because they fight differently. They don't care if you kill them; they keep coming.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood”: the Carmanians are Iran, the Persians. “And with great power shall they come”: not with weakness, with great power. The last time anyone looked, to have power you have to have weapons, and Iran is firing weapons America didn't even know they had, while the government asks how they got the technology.

The media guesses: they only have a few thousand missiles, we destroyed most of them. That is a lie. Much of their weaponry is in the mountains where America cannot reach it. Iran has been preparing twenty years for this war, and if America puts boots on the ground it is going to be a bloodbath. Why die for the white man? What has the white man ever done for us?

Keep this scripture in mind as we watch what unfolds. “Be not curious in unnecessary matters”: mind your business. What is going on right now is not your business; stay in the scriptures. There is no feeling sorry for the white man or the Arab. Both have their hands in the destruction of our people. They want you to feel sorry because they killed 160 little girls, but they killed over 100 million of us and nobody says a thing. They are still killing our people in the Sudan right now, financed by the UAE, and the closing of the Strait of Hormuz has cut the route they used to run weapons there. Everything has a reason. Through this war our salvation comes. As long as they are not killing our people, let them fight each other; we only care about our people, whom they have been killing for centuries.

“For more things are shewed unto thee than men understand.” Whatever little thing you know, even if you only know Deuteronomy 28, you know more than the people outside this room. This is why the media does not understand what is going on: the scripture tells us something totally different from what they are saying. America and Israel are trying to stop the prophecy with their regime change, and it is not going to happen. The professionals who went to school for this are guessing. We know the prophecy, and that is the advantage we have.

“For many are deceived by their own vain opinion”: your opinion doesn't matter. The only opinion that matters is the Most High God's. Outside of this Bible your opinion does not mean a damn thing; stick to the word and repeat what the word says. God's word is where the power is.

“And an evil suspicion hath overthrown their judgment”: evil suspicion has overthrown men's judgment. The pride of America's heart has deceived it. Like Tyson, who was knocking everybody out and did not even study Buster Douglas, a nobody whose one punch erased everything Tyson had done, America thinks no one can take it down. It is going to take one black man, Jesus the Christ, and the scripture says he will do it in one hour.

When we see all these things happen, get yourself together. “But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel”: we are Israel.

“Fear not.” When you see war all over the world, keep in mind the prophecy has to come to pass. This is what we have been getting you ready for for years; the Bishop taught a whole series on the book of Revelation years ago. Preparing yourself does not only mean getting food and water; that is half prepared. Prepare yourself mentally, and prepare yourself spiritually by reading and studying. If something popped off right now, some of you would not survive a month, because you still think this is the promised land and nothing will ever happen here.

America, the white man, has a system where they create chaos to introduce new laws to oppress the people. September 11 was an inside job, and after it came the Patriot Act and homeland security. Eighty percent of the people are against the war in Iran, so watch for something big to happen here to turn them. Pay attention to your surroundings. Stop walking around on your phone in la-la land, and when you hear something happen, do not run to go see it.

“Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord”: the Israelites are God's witnesses. “And my servant whom I have chosen”: we are God's servants, chosen and sent to bring back the nation of Israel. Do not forget the mission.

Some of you have been sitting here for years and are still in regular clothes; that says you forgot the mission. When you first walked in you knew what it was, but in the middle of the mission you got comfortable. Some of you never went through anything. You forgot the purpose, what you were called for, what you signed up for. Some of you need to learn how to live in a third world country. It is time to face reality.

“That ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.” Before the God of Israel there was no God, and there will be no God after him. The only God that exists is the God of Israel.

precepts.why:
Get your mind ready for what is coming. “A true witness delivereth souls”: a true witness, a true prophet, a true servant delivers souls. God called us his witnesses; so whose souls have you been delivering? Some of you can't even deliver your own soul, because you forgot the mission. You have been sitting five, six, seven, ten years. Who are you working for? Some of you are agents working for Esau. Spiritually, are you working for Messiah or for Satan? Some of you don't even know the title of your job.

“But a deceitful witness speaketh lies.” You are that deceitful witness. Our people love lies and you are feeding them lies. That is why the Christian churches hold ten and twenty thousand: they love lies and do not want the truth. The negro says Christ can't be black, Christ can't come only for the Israelites, he has to be for everybody. To us the truth is a foreign language.

“In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence.” Some of you have no confidence, low self-esteem, because you have no fear of God. You have been in the same seat for seven years: when are you going to get up and say enough is enough? The Most High did not send you here just to sit and listen and wait for the kingdom. The kingdom does not come by observation; you have to work for it. Whoever will not do the work cannot be trusted, and will be the first to turn when persecution shows up, like the one who betrayed Christ for thirty pieces of silver. Today it would take only one.

You want the kingdom and you watch all these wars, Russia and Ukraine getting worse and worse, but you just sit there waiting.

“This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply”: it is our job to rebuke our people sharply. Why? “That they may be sound in the faith”: so that they may repent. That is the work of a true witness.

There is a lot of work to do while you wait for the kingdom. We all want the kingdom but we don't want to work for it; we want to slide by, and the Most High is not going to let you slide by. When temptation and tribulation come you will run, because mentally and spiritually you are not strong enough to endure. When persecution rises up, you will be surprised how many brothers and wives run.

“For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son.” To be conformed is to change. We must change to the image of Jesus Christ, and some of you have not changed yet. We can see the potential on you, the spirit to do great things in Israel, but you have to see it. Our job is to push your spirit and build you up, but nobody can make you see it. You have to get up and see it yourself.

“That he might be the firstborn among many brethren.”
“Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself.” Predestinated unto the adoption of children by what, by whom? By Jesus Christ, to himself.

sense.text:
“For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of”: Paul understood he was a servant, sent to serve the people and deliver souls. Paul is saying, I'm a nobody.

“For necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!” Paul understood his purpose and what he was called for: destruction unto me if I don't teach the gospel, if I don't do what I was sent to do. How many of you can say that? Be honest with yourself. What have you done since you came to IUIC, except show up every Sabbath, open the Bible and sit there? Some of you only pick up the Bible on Saturday, because when we ask you a simple question in the scripture, you cannot answer it.

“For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward”: that is the word. You have to prepare to do this willingly, not because someone tells you. Some of you leave class and do nothing at the house, not willing to build yourself up. We correct you, we see you change for two weeks, then you are back doing the same thing; that says it was not willingly, it was forced. Leaders, never force a brother to do anything. If he says no to sweeping the floor, leave him alone and get another brother, because when you force a man there is no spirit in it.

Paul said that if he did not do it willingly, he would have no reward. The reward is the kingdom of heaven. Some of you force yourself to be here every Saturday like a burden, taking a seat someone else could have had, yet every Monday you willingly get up at 4:00 in the morning to give the white man eight or twelve hours without complaining, even in pain. You love massa. What is more important, the kingdom of heaven or the master's job? The kingdom of heaven has no end, but this place is going. America turns 250 this July; go and study how long every kingdom before it lasted before it fell.

“But if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me”: if I have been forced day after day to be here and do the work, nobody can depend on me.
“What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge”: Paul was willing to teach the gospel freely. He did not charge.

“For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all”: Bishop Nathanyel is a servant, the Bishops are servants, and we the deacons are servants. We are Christ's servants, here to serve the people. That is our job and what we were called for: to make sure you are right, to build you up the right way, and to tell you how to be ready for what is coming. “That I might gain the more.”

Keep this in mind all through the class. “Be not ignorant of any thing in a great matter or a small.” This is especially for the men. It does not mean be a professional in everything; it means know a little bit about everything. When you know a little about everything, it is hard for somebody to lie to you, and a lot of you are going to get fooled by what comes on social media, because you don't study and you don't pay attention to what is going on.

A man is supposed to know what is going on, because the men are the leaders. You check the weather for tomorrow so you know how to go to work; know the world the same way. You don't have to watch hours of news. Ten or fifteen minutes is enough, and watch what has just come out, not what is days old, because the regular news lies. When somebody starts talking about something, know what they are talking about so you don't look clueless. The war has been going for almost three weeks and some of you still have no clue, living in la-la land, thinking nothing has ever happened here.

Don't sleep on Psalm 91. This is what God said. “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” The secret place of the Most High is the scriptures. Stay in the scriptures, and in prayer: that is our protection.

“Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day.” Read this as if you were not living here but in Iran, in Israel, in Gaza. The arrows are missiles. You don't know when a missile is going to hit your home, your car or the building you work in; they may aim at the house next to you and miss, and hit yours. Two weeks ago, parents dressed 160 young girls and sent them to school, and a missile came out of nowhere and killed everybody. The teachers who woke up that morning did not know they were not coming back.

That is the mindset men and leaders need: it is not if, it is when. Take the mindset that it can never happen here out of your head.

“Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” Noonday matters: you get up, shower, drive to the job you have had for twenty years, and at noonday you sit down to eat your lunch. It is a normal life. Out of nowhere, while you are eating your little sandwich, a missile comes. You did not know, because your mindset is, this is America.

In the 250 years America is about to celebrate, how many wars have other nations fought against America on its own soil? That is why some of you are so comfortable: nobody ever fought America here, so you think it can never happen.

“Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation; There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.” The one who makes the Most High his habitation, dwelling in the scriptures and in prayer, is the one kept when the terror comes.
“In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself unto Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt”: the angel is speaking to Ezra of the bush where he talked with Moses.

“And I sent him, and led my people out of Egypt”: take this as today. He spoke to his servant Moses and sent him to deliver his people out of Egypt while they served in it. America is the spiritual Egypt, and the prophets, we, are the Moses of today. Our job is to bring back the twelve tribes. He held Moses by him “a long season”.

“And told him many wondrous things, and shewed him the secrets of the times, and the end”: God revealed to Moses the beginning, the middle and the end. Moses saw it all. That is why Moses was not bugging out when God told him he would only see the promised land and not go in: he had already been shown how everything ends. He saw us go into slavery; that is how he was able to write Deuteronomy 28. This world and what is going on right now, Moses saw it all.

“These words shalt thou declare, and these shalt thou hide.” The prophets did not show Israel everything; there is still more hidden. But what we have been given is enough for us to make it to the kingdom.

That is why we read earlier not to entangle yourself in unnecessary matters. Nothing is wrong with reading other books, but there is only one book that can get you where you want to go, the Bible. The scriptures must be your number one focus. Other books can be number two and number three, but only the scriptures can get you out of here.

precepts.why:
The things you know, men do not know. Solomon says the Most High God gave him “certain knowledge of the things that are, namely, to know how the world was made”: God showed Solomon how the world was created, when he said, let there be light.

“And the operation of the elements”: water, air and fire. God showed Solomon how the elements operate, even how to work them. You breathe the air and don't know where it comes from. There is a spirit in the fire; a little fire can consume this whole place. Everything runs into the ocean and the ocean never overflows. Ask your Solomon why. These are things too heavy for us, as Christ said we cannot even number the hairs of our head, but God showed them to Solomon. The scripture says no king before or after had his knowledge; the greatest king to walk the earth, so full of knowledge it almost consumed him.

“The beginning, ending, and midst of the times”: so Moses in Ezra was not the only one. Solomon too was shown the beginning, the middle and the end of time. That is heavy. This book is so big you can spend your lifetime in it and never master it, and anyone who says he knows everything in the Bible is a fool. As time goes by, more of the spiritual world opens to the Bishops; Bishop Nathanyel does not teach today the way he taught back then. We have not even seen ten percent of what was shown to Solomon. The waters are rising; be patient.

sense.text:
We should read this scripture more often, especially at camp. “Remember this, and shew yourselves men”: God is talking to us. Some of you are still little boys. You have been sitting four years; it is time to walk into your manhood. We are men, we are prophets, we are leaders.

“Bring it again to mind”: bring to mind who you are, the scriptures, why you were sent here, the mission. When you first walked through that door, do you remember why? Do you remember what happened in your life, why you repented, why you left the Christian church? Some of you have gone back to it, one foot in and one foot out; in the middle you forgot why you left. God is saying, remember why you left, remember why you started believing, why you know, you are an Israelite. “O ye transgressors”: O you sinners.

“Remember the former things of old”: Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, our forefathers; Moses and Jeremiah; how Moses delivered us out of Egypt; a time when we were righteous and did not play with sin. What happened to us? We are the greatest people that ever set foot on this planet, the Israelites, the sons of the living God.

If you want the kingdom of heaven, you must accept what comes with it: war, tribulation, death. Are you ready? “I am God, and there is none like me.”

“Declaring the end from the beginning”: only the God of Israel can declare the end from the beginning, and God shows it only to the prophets, to us. That is why the media has no idea what is about to happen, and neither does the Christian church. Ask your pastor what is coming and he will say Jesus wept; they are too busy asking a thousand people for a thousand dollars. Ask T.D. Jakes with thousands in his church, ask Creflo Dollar, ask the preachers prophesying about Iran, ask Michael Todd. None of them has a clue, because they all think America will last forever, and all they care about is the money in your pocket.

“And from ancient times”: the prophets, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Moses, Solomon, King David. From the beginning these men prophesied what is happening now, and we are watching it in the scriptures plainly. Our forefathers put this Bible together; this is not the white man's book. The prophets described what they saw to the best of their ability; they had never seen a missile or an iron dome. When a prophet said he saw stars falling from heaven, those were missiles. Put yourself in the prophet's shoes, because you are the prophets who saw it; you just don't remember.

“The things that are not yet done”: Christians and pastors cannot declare a thing. World War III has not begun yet, but by the events happening we can see we are on our way there. With the Strait of Hormuz closed, oil is at a hundred dollars a barrel and gas past five dollars a gallon after only two weeks. Iran is destroying the world economy and bringing the dollar down. America will let it happen so they can bring in digital currency, and digital currency comes with a digital ID, where they control what you buy, what you eat and what you wear. Fuel moves the food from the boat to the port, to the warehouse, to your grocery store, so food will go up and small businesses will shut down. That is why the Bishop told you to buy the food while it was cheap.

“Saying, My counsel shall stand”: God's counsel is the prophecies, the Bible. His word does not go out void; whatever we read here will happen. The white man is trying to stop the prophecy of 2 Esdras 15, and he cannot stop it. They cannot even destroy Hamas in a land right under their nose; Iran is seven times bigger. The government of Lebanon says it cannot control Hezbollah, and Hezbollah fires a hundred missiles into Israel while the media says they have no weapons. Go with what the Bible says, not with what the white man says.

precepts.why:
This is the prophet who said that when these things hit, they hurt. When a missile hits it brings destruction, and you do not want to be within ten feet of it.

“When I heard, my belly trembled”: that is fear, an anxiety inside you, the thing in your chest when you cannot believe what you are watching, what the Most High is showing you. “My lips quivered at the voice”: he was shaking so he could not talk straight. “Rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself”: he could not believe the damage this thing was doing, the number of people it was killing.

“That I might rest in the day of trouble”: I don't want to be alive to see this, it is so bad. This is what Psalm 91 speaks of with the thousands falling at your side: he saw the bomb drop and ten thousand people die right there. The prophets declared from ancient times the things not yet done, and this is what they saw.

sense.text:
“Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you.” Christ is not talking about peace on the earth. He is talking about spiritual peace, peace of mind, and there is no price for peace of mind. Stop bothering yourself with everything and focus on what you need to focus on.

There is nothing wrong with getting up and going to work to pay your bills, spending time with your wife and your children. But at the end of the day your mind is supposed to be on the work of Messiah. That comes first: not your job, not your wife, not your children, but the kingdom of heaven and the work for Messiah. Messiah first; everything else is second.

“For God hath not given us the spirit of fear.” None of us should have the spirit of fear. How do you not have it? By expecting the unexpected: reading, reading, reading, getting familiar with the scriptures and the prophecies, so that when it happens you already knew it was going to happen. If you have already set your mind that they are going to kill you one day for this, then when Esau shows up, fear will not jump on you. It will not be easy, but prepare your mind.

Prepare your mind so that fear does not get on you so badly that you betray the brother or the sister who sits next to you. Some of you are going to betray based on fear. Esau says, I'm going to tell the congregation you were watching gay porn, and you are afraid, so you betray your brothers because you don't want that to come out and the men to look at you different. You were not prepared; your mind was never in the scriptures, you were on porn, and that is why you got caught up out there. Prepare yourself.

With AI today they are going to set a lot of us up. Esau is so evil; it is already coming. They could show a video of the deacon effing a goat, and some of our own people are going to believe it with no proof: oh yeah, I know the man, that's not AI. They will believe it because they did not build their minds in the scriptures.

“Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.” David is speaking to himself, to his soul. Put plainly: I might be down, but I'm not broken. I might be down, but I'm not out. Satan tried to take me out, but my hope is in the Lord and I still have some fight in me.

Some of you are quick to give up and run as soon as something happens: why did they have to put correction on me? Correction is a good thing. It keeps you on your toes and makes you better and stronger; what doesn't break you makes you stronger. A brother's correction can build another brother up, when you see it and say, let me move from what he got corrected for. Moses said some must be corrected openly, so that fear falls on the others. Some of you were never corrected in your life until you came to IUIC, and you are too prideful to take it.

Never have yes men around you. A man in your circle who cannot correct you hates you and is waiting for your downfall. You want men who will say, brother, don't do that, don't talk like that, don't talk evil of leadership, go to your brother if you have a problem with him. The same with the sisters: the sister who tells you what you did not want to hear is the one you want around you.

“I am feeble and sore broken”: David says he is feeble and broken. “I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart”: to roar is to utter or express in a loud tone, to cry, shout, yell. David cried out from the trouble of his heart.

“Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.” When some of you pray, you do not pray for yourself, because you think you are perfect. You need to pray for yourself. When you fast, pray that Messiah helps you overcome your lust; we all have lust, just in different things. Some of you are fighting a covetous spirit: pray that Messiah helps you overcome it. Put your groaning before him.

You will not walk into the kingdom of heaven thinking you are perfect. “And he that overcometh”: Christ said he that overcomes. You must overcome the lust of America, and you must overcome the personal things you struggle with: lust, porn, prostitution, drugs. Some of you are crackheads, weed heads, cigarettes, Black and Milds, women. And yes, it is said to shame you.

“And keepeth my works unto the end”: keep his commandments, keep his laws. His works are this book. If you keep this, you have overcome. You must overcome, or you will not make it to the kingdom, and everything you see happening, do not count yourself in it, because you will not make it if you won't let the lust go.

Some of you need to let go of things. Some of you hold on to things that happened five, twenty, fifty years ago. The men especially should not be like that; that is emotion, like the woman who brings up the pineapple from five years ago when you are talking about the orange.

“For gold is tried in the fire”: you are that gold, we are that gold. How do you purify gold? By putting it in the fire. Some of you need to go into the fire. You have stuff on you the Most High is trying to purge out, and you want to keep it and still have the kingdom of heaven. If you won't be purged, you cannot have the kingdom; you have to be that gold, not iron, not silver. Esau has put you through hell all your life. What is the purpose of going through all that and missing the kingdom because you held on to things and would not let God take the unclean out of you?

“And acceptable men in the furnace of adversity”: it takes a strong man to take correction; weak men cannot take it. When correction comes, the strong man gets up, repents and keeps moving, and you can tell he is still in the fight. When you get correction, that is when you push harder. Don't lay back. Prove to Messiah, not to leadership, that you are still in the fight.

Some of you are depressed; it is all over your face, and depression kills people. “Give not over thy mind to heaviness.” Every bishop, deacon, captain and officer is preparing you for what is coming. Rent, mortgages, food and gas are going to go sky-high; there will be a time you pay ten dollars a gallon. Can you change it? Then why let it be heavy on your spirit? Heaviness brings stress, and stress will kill you. Don't try to change what you cannot change. None of us knows what tomorrow brings; you can plan, but why worry about tomorrow?

“And afflict not thyself in thine own counsel”: some of you are your own biggest enemy. Yes, the white man is the devil, but he is not your biggest enemy; you are. You hold yourself back and bring stress and depression on yourself. Some of you will find yourselves living outside America, without power and internet and hot water 24/7, without even a candle in the house, and you will be depressed, because the white man has been good to you. Your time is coming.

“The gladness of the heart is the life of man”: when you are happy, it brings life to you, and some joy brings a longer life. Think of the opposite: why does the husband always drop dead before the wife? He lets stress and worry wear him out into the grave, while she is happy. Do you die from the food, the death in the pot, the high cholesterol, or from stress? People who left America say the sickness left them and the energy came back. This place was created to kill us.

“Love thine own soul”: some of you hate yourselves. Love your soul and take care of your body: walk an hour a day. A brother lost a great deal of weight only by walking around his neighborhood an hour every day and changing his diet. Walk before you go home after a long shift, because once you are in the house you have more excuses than a crackhead.

“And comfort thy heart, remove sorrow far from thee”: some of you love sorrow. “For sorrow hath killed many”: stress and worry have killed many, and you are no different. Stop worrying about what you cannot change. Food and gas are going up and you are not getting a raise, but when you prepare for what you know is coming, you will not stress over it. You see ten dollars a gallon and you already knew, because you read the scriptures; the Most High God already told you, so your mind is prepared. It is what it is.

precepts.why:
“Weep bitterly, and make great moan, and use lamentation, as he is worthy, and that a day or two, lest thou be evil spoken of: and then comfort thyself for thy heaviness.” This is speaking of when somebody passes: mourn a day or two, then comfort yourself, and do not stay in the heaviness.

Why? “For of heaviness cometh death”: heaviness, stress, brings death. “And the heaviness of the heart breaketh strength”: stress makes you weak. Stress keeps you from working out, from going to work; it makes some people eat more, and eating more makes you gain weight, and that leads eventually to death. Men especially, when you are stressed you lay back and become fat and sloppy.

Do not let stress wear you down so that you don't want to do the work of the Most High. Some of you have sat here five or six years in regular clothes while you watch the prophecies come to pass and wars all over the place; it is a matter of time before World War III. What is keeping you back? Sin. Examine yourself. The Most High God is doing his part; it is time we do ours.

sense.text:
“A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance”: a joyful heart makes a cheerful face. “But by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.” Those who have been with us for years, we can see the change right in your face. Correction comes and you totally change; even after you come back, your spirit is not the same, because you hold grudges. Satan tells you the correction wasn't right. We can see that dark countenance, that cloud, on your face.

You are no longer the way you were with certain brothers; you keep to yourself, and that is when Satan really messes with you, telling you things that are not true about that man or that sister. You open the door for him. Correction is grievous, but it can be a good thing or a bad thing, and it is up to you. Use it to build yourself up.
